sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.title: Run Qwen3.8-27B Locally: 24GB Mac and GPU Guide (2026)
sources.snippet: TL;DR: Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27B vision-language model under Apache-2.0 with 262,144-token context and MTP decoding. The Q4 build is about 17.8GB, so a 24GB Mac or GPU runs it comfortably, and AMD measured 24.5 tok/s on Ryzen AI Max+ 395. One command to start: ollama run qwen3.8:27b. What Makes Qwen3.8-27B Different?

sources.title: How to Run Qwen 3.8 27B on Your Own Computer - lu-labs.ai
sources.snippet: The 2.4 trillion parameter giant opened up on 12 August under Alibaba's own qwen3.8-max licence, and it needs a data center either way. Qwen 3.8 27B followed on 13 August under Apache 2.0, and it is a dense model built to fit on a single graphics card or a decent laptop. This post is about the 27B.
